slides.title: Selling at a Christmas market this year?
slides.sub: The £1,000 tax-free allowance is on your total sales, not your profit.

slides.title: The £1,000 trading allowance
body: Total sales of £1,000 or less a year are usually tax-free.
It is total sales before costs.

slides.title: Over £1,000? Pick one
body: Or take off the £1,000 allowance instead.

slides.title: Worked example
slides.result: The allowance gives the lower figure: £400 to report.
slides.note: No other trading income, 2026/27 tax year, illustration only.

slides.title: What about the £3,000?
body: The allowance is due to rise to £3,000.
That is planned from 6 April 2027, and not yet law.
